name: What maintenance is required for non-slip flooring?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required for non-slip flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintenance for non-slip flooring typically involves regular cleaning to prevent dirt and debris from accumulating in the textured surface, which can reduce its slip resistance. The specific cleaning methods depend on the material; some may require mild detergents and brushes, while others tolerate harsher cleaners. Avoid abrasive cleaners that could damage the texture. Periodic inspections for wear and tear are also recommended. Proper maintenance ensures the flooring retains its safety features and extends its lifespan effectively.
acceptedAnswer.description: Regular cleaning is crucial to prevent dirt accumulation that reduces slip resistance. Specific methods vary by material; avoid abrasive cleaners.
